description: Correlate captured runtime evidence into a root-cause diagnosis. Returns status (diagnosed|unknown), summary, rootCause, evidence (each with a citable eventId), a chronological timeline around the root cause, alternativeCauses that also fit, limitations describing what could not be seen, confidence (0-1) with a breakdown of evidence strength / data completeness / alternative strength, and recommended fixes. Status is 'unknown' below 70% rather than a guess.
name: diagnose_runtime
title: Diagnose runtime
